verses.text: Thus the Lord GOD showed me, and behold, He was forming a locust-swarm when the spring crop began to sprout. And behold, the spring crop [was] after the king's mowing.
verses.textZh: 主耶和華指示我一件事：為王割菜（或譯：草）之後，菜又發生；剛發生的時候，主造蝗蟲。

verses.text: And it came about, when it had finished eating the vegetation of the land, that I said, 'Lord GOD, please pardon! How can Jacob stand, For he is small?'
verses.textZh: 蝗蟲吃盡那地的青物，我就說：主耶和華啊，求你赦免；因為雅各微弱，他怎能站立得住呢？

verses.text: The LORD changed His mind about this. 'It shall not be,' said the LORD.
verses.textZh: 耶和華就後悔，說：這災可以免了。

verses.text: Thus the Lord GOD showed me, and behold, the Lord GOD was calling to contend [with them] by fire, and it consumed the great deep and began to consume the farm land.
verses.textZh: 主耶和華又指示我一件事：他命火來懲罰以色列，火就吞滅深淵，險些將地燒滅。

verses.text: Then I said, 'Lord GOD, please stop! How can Jacob stand, for he is small?'
verses.textZh: 我就說：主耶和華啊，求你止息；因為雅各微弱，他怎能站立得住呢？

verses.text: The LORD changed His mind about this. 'This too shall not be,' said the Lord GOD.
verses.textZh: 耶和華就後悔，說：這災也可免了。

verses.text: Thus He showed me, and behold, the Lord was standing by a vertical wall with a plumb line in His hand.
verses.textZh: 他又指示我一件事：有一道牆是按準繩建築的，主手拿準繩站在其上。

verses.text: The LORD said to me, 'What do you see, Amos?' And I said, 'A plumb line.' Then the Lord said, 'Behold I am about to put a plumb line In the midst of My people Israel. I will spare them no longer.
verses.textZh: 耶和華對我說：阿摩司啊，你看見甚麼？我說：看見準繩。主說：我要吊起準繩在我民以色列中，我必不再寬恕他們。

verses.text: 'The high places of Isaac will be desolated And the sanctuaries of Israel laid waste. Then I will rise up against the house of Jeroboam with the sword.'
verses.textZh: 以撒的邱壇必然淒涼，以色列的聖所必然荒廢。我必興起，用刀攻擊耶羅波安的家。

verses.text: Then Amaziah, the priest of Bethel, sent [word] to Jeroboam king of Israel, saying, 'Amos has conspired against you in the midst of the house of Israel; the land is unable to endure all his words.
verses.textZh: 伯特利的祭司亞瑪謝打發人到以色列王耶羅波安那裡，說：阿摩司在以色列家中圖謀背叛你；他所說的一切話，這國擔當不起；

verses.text: 'For thus Amos says, 'Jeroboam will die by the sword and Israel will certainly go from its land into exile.''
verses.textZh: 因為阿摩司如此說：耶羅波安必被刀殺，以色列民定被擄去離開本地。

verses.text: Then Amaziah said to Amos, 'Go, you seer, flee away to the land of Judah and there eat bread and there do your prophesying!
verses.textZh: 亞瑪謝又對阿摩司說：你這先見哪，要逃往猶大地去，在那裡糊口，在那裡說預言，

verses.text: 'But no longer prophesy at Bethel, for it is a sanctuary of the king and a royal residence.'
verses.textZh: 卻不要在伯特利再說預言；因為這裡有王的聖所，有王的宮殿。

verses.text: Then Amos replied to Amaziah, 'I am not a prophet, nor am I the son of a prophet; for I am a herdsman and a grower of sycamore figs.
verses.textZh: 阿摩司對亞瑪謝說：我原不是先知，也不是先知的門徒（原文是兒子）。我是牧人，又是修理桑樹的。

verses.text: 'But the LORD took me from following the flock and the LORD said to me, 'Go prophesy to My people Israel.'
verses.textZh: 耶和華選召我，使我不跟從羊群，對我說：你去向我民以色列說預言。

verses.text: 'Now hear the word of the LORD: you are saying, 'You shall not prophesy against Israel nor shall you speak against the house of Isaac.'
verses.textZh: 亞瑪謝啊，現在你要聽耶和華的話。你說：不要向以色列說預言，也不要向以撒家滴下預言。

verses.text: 'Therefore, thus says the LORD, 'Your wife will become a harlot in the city, your sons and your daughters will fall by the sword, your land will be parceled up by a [measuring] line and you yourself will die upon unclean soil. Moreover, Israel will certainly go from its land into exile.''
verses.textZh: 所以耶和華如此說：你的妻子必在城中作妓女，你的兒女必倒在刀下；你的地必有人用繩子量了分取，你自己必死在污穢之地。以色列民定被擄去離開本地。
